volc.title: Volcengine (LLM / Vision)
volc.cvDesc: AccessKey (ID) + SecretAccessKey for Volcengine CV Img2ImgInpainting. Takes priority over OpenAI-compatible channel when configured; otherwise use the 'Image Inpaint' model library entry.
volc.cvAccessKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current AK
volc.cvHostExtra: Usually leave empty, resolved by SDK; fill visual domain (without https://) for special network environments
volc.watermarkDesc: Optional: Add an 'Image Inpaint' entry in Model Management with OpenAI-compatible Base URL and images.edit model ID. If Volcengine CV is configured, it takes priority; otherwise this entry is used. Below are prompt and max video frames.
volc.maxFramesExtra: Exceeding this triggers FFmpeg delogo for the entire video; prevents long videos from overwhelming the API.
volc.inpaintPlaceholder: Describe how to naturally fill the watermark area
